facts.text: Gotham, tonight's parade is on me. Come hungry, and keep your hands off the hair gel.
facts.why: Not a Joker line. The quote page has lines such as 'If you've gotta go, go with a smile!' and 'Wait till they get a load of ME!' Printed in quote marks and signed The Joker.
facts.fix: If you've gotta go, go with a smile!

fix_note.text: Wait till they get a load of ME!

facts.text: Smilex in the hair gel and lipstick
facts.why: The film spells it Smylex, and Batman names hairspray, lipstick and perfume as the poisoned products. Hair gel is never named.
facts.fix: Smylex in the hairspray and lipstick

facts.why: The Joker promises the gas at midnight at the parade. No source gives 11:30, and the line is built by the layout, so no stored text matches.

facts.text: Vicki's lunch table, before the Joker redecorates.
facts.why: The Joker lures Vicki to the Flugelheim Museum, which his men vandalise. No lunch table scene shows in the plot or transcript.
facts.fix: Vicki at the Flugelheim, before the Joker redecorates.

facts.text: Vicki's order, waiting on her mystery lunch date.
facts.why: No mystery lunch date shows in the plot or transcript. The Joker lures Vicki to the Flugelheim Museum.
facts.fix: Vicki's order, before the Joker visits the museum.

vibe.verdict: Smart parade cue and a nice cafe, but it skips the Joker's best moments and leans on a lunch scene that is not in the film.
